name: excytin-bench
description:
The dataset is composed of 2 parts. 

The raw logs stored as csv files that will be used in a MYSQL database. All files are stored in the data_anonymized.tar.gz tar file. You should download it directly, instead of loading it using huggingface load_dataset function. Use the framework provided in the github repo to setup the log database.
The question answer pairs for the benchmark used in the paper can be found under the questions directory. These can be loaded directly using the hugging face… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Godota/excytin-bench.
evaluation_method: exact_match / accuracy on Q&A and SQL correctness (execution/exact-match of expected answers)
reputation: A niche benchmark hosted on Hugging Face combining raw anonymized logs and QA pairs for process/log reasoning; limited but growing use in process-mining and DB-to-NLP communities.
